case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to put this job onto the shop floor. We want to give your shop steady work on the HX pump shaft, and our proposal below is built so that both family companies can plan with it.

Several bidders are competing for this part, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance. Here is how we see your offer:

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On price level:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material cost:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

This is the package we can approve. It reflects the quality record, the competing offer and the movement in bar prices, and it gives your shop a clear, fair basis for this job.

We would like to continue working with you, and we look forward to your reply on this proposal.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I looked at your numbers on the material and the competition, and you have a point. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

The 14 days payment term works well for us, so I will take that and the 35 days lead time. I can come down to €30.50 per unit to keep the machines running for you. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

So our offer stands at a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

You wrote that you need to clarify this internally, so we have made our proposal easy to take through that step.

Several bidders are still competing for the HX pump shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance, but we are making a serious effort to close with you.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

This is the package we can approve. It keeps your CNC machines running on a part you already know, with the payment term and the lead time you said work well for you.

For whoever has to approve this on your side: Option A gives Zerspanung Dralveck a payment term it has already accepted, a lead time it has already agreed and work for the shop floor on a new pump series from a customer it knows. Every invoice will be paid on its agreed due date. It is a fair number for two family companies that want to plan together, and it can be approved as it stands.

Please take Option A up internally and let us know where you land. We would like to find the way to make this work with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. I took this up internally as you suggested. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price.

Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner. Option A below is built for that: it gives you the planning security of a clear term sheet with us, and it is the package we can approve.

Two points bear directly on your offer.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Several bidders are competing for this pump shaft for the new HX series, and the award goes to the best package. We have chosen Option A because the quality record and the surcharge trend support a price well below your offer, while the payment term gives your business a predictable, long-term basis.

For your management, in short: Option A gives Strojírna Hrvelec a clear and orderly place in the HX series with us. Please take Option A to the person who decides on your side, so that it can be approved as it stands.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I looked at the alloy and quality numbers you sent, fair point, so I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR. We can't do 35 days lead time without charging a lot extra for the rush, so I kept it at 52 days. Let's stick to 45 days payment to keep things simple. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This alternative is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days at our standard terms.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
